prompts.cafe:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: a real-looking editorial photograph for a Japanese AI learning and small-business support website. Create a new standalone 1536x1024 landscape photograph, 3:2. Restrained, sophisticated Japanese lifestyle magazine art direction, visually clean, airy, natural human warmth. Contemporary light oak, warm white plaster, ecru and deep charcoal palette; beautiful soft daylight and realistic skin/fabric texture. Candid concentration, never looking into camera, no exaggerated advertising smiles. People and essential action in the central 80 percent so modest responsive cropping works. No typography overlay, logos, watermarks, abstract art, surreal elements, neon, floating UI, or clutter. Desktop screens and keyboards must be physically oriented toward their users, seen at an oblique angle by the camera; natural adult hands. This is a fictional illustrative scene, not a real customer portrait.
Scene: a quietly stylish small independent coffee shop before opening, a single elegant pale oak counter and mostly empty warm-white wall in background. Main subject a Japanese woman shop owner in her late thirties, relaxed ivory blouse and understated olive apron, seated alongside a Japanese female adviser around forty in a charcoal linen jacket. Only TWO adults total, occupying about half the frame, calm smaller figures with ample breathing room. The owner operates one laptop as the adviser gently indicates a detail on its screen. Shoot a wider three-quarter side view, not a frontal staged stock photograph. The laptop has a simple promotional layout featuring one coffee photograph, no need for legible text. One handmade ceramic cup, one closed notebook on the generous otherwise empty table; no food spread, no extra devices. Clear story: a woman business owner learning to make her own shop announcement with friendly one-to-one help. Balanced asymmetrical composition, soft window shadow on blank wall, contemporary and refined without being luxurious or artsy.

prompts.build:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: an editorial photograph for a Japanese AI learning and small-business support website. New standalone 1536x1024 landscape 3:2 photograph. Sophisticated but accessible contemporary Japanese lifestyle magazine photography. Warm white plaster, pale oak, ecru and ink navy, very soft daylight, realistic hands and fabric texture. Restrained natural expression, no camera eye contact, no stock-photo handshake, no exaggerated grin, no logos/watermarks/typography overlays, no abstract art or futuristic effects. Spacious clean composition with very few objects. Subjects and essential action in central 80 percent for responsive cropping. Screens face their users naturally; camera sees screens only obliquely from the same viewing side. Fictional illustrative scene.
Scene: a small independent design consultancy's clean workroom with one warm white wall and a subtle soft window shadow; no cafe. One Japanese male independent business owner in his forties wearing a casual cream overshirt, naturally seated at a generous light oak table. He quietly examines his smartphone while a slim laptop beside it shows the same simple booking calendar page. A female consultant is present only as a secondary partial shoulder and one gently indicating hand at the edge of the composition; the owner is the single fully visible person. Wide side-view composition, ample tabletop and uncluttered wall, business owner not filling frame. On both screens a simple tasteful booking grid with muted teal calendar cells; screens are realistically angled toward the owner, not presented to the camera. One closed notebook, no other props. Clear realistic story: checking a newly made booking website on computer and smartphone with friendly expert help. Calm confident human scene, subtle editorial finish without theatrical styling.
